{{Quote|Kalpana would certainly set a different tone, but perhaps an equally risky one. His stance against piratism, smuggling, even slavery is well known.|Darth Plagueis|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
'''Kalpana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] who served as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] before [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]. Kalpana was part of the influential [[Kalpana family]]. During his [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|chancellery]], as part of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] grandiose projects, the [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]] was built, only to be lost during its maiden voyage, and the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] occurred in the [[Troiken system/Legends|Troiken system]]. 

==Biography==
Kalpana was a member of an [[Kalpana family|influential family]] allied with [[House Valorum/Legends|House Valorum]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Finis Valorum served in Kalpana's administration while still a [[Senator/Legends|senator]].<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> He also rode an [[Eddicus-class planetary shuttle/Legends|''Eddicus''-class planetary shuttle]] that had been bugged by Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|vehicle|valorumshuttle|shuttle, Chancellor Valorum's}}</ref>

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], Kalpana had received a request from [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[SonTag]] of [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] [[Mission to Bandomeer|travel]] to the planet and act as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] representative for business concerning the [[Offworld Mining Corporation]]. However, unknown to the Chancellor, the message was forged by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xanatos]] to lure his former Master into a trap.<ref name="Rising Force">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]''</ref> It was during Kalpana's Chancellorship that the [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]] was built and lost, and the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] occurred later that year.
